caseNameFull: Elmer H. Duffield v. Henry F. Ashurst, as District Attorney, etc.
summary: Appeal from' the Supreme Court of the Territory of Arizona.
attorneys: Mr. T. J. Norton, Mr. Gardiner Lathrop, and Mr. Robert Dunlap for the appellant. Mr. Edward M. Doe for the appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Appeal dismissed with costs. United States ex rel. Warden v. Chandler, 122 U. S. 643; Bernardin v. Butterworth, 169 U. S. 600; Security Mutual Life Insurance Co. v. Prewitt, 200 U. S. 446, 449, and cases cited, and cause remanded to the Supreme Court of the; State of Arizona.
